scope: CVG-004 bounded on-demand server-backed inventory movement ledger report and audited export

criteria.description: The catalog, permissions, raw ledger grain, strict filters, deterministic order, exact thirteen-field contract, row bound and explicit non-promotion exclusions are implemented and covered.
criteria.limitations: The Vetus corpus establishes the report surface but not an authoritative dynamic-executor schema; this gate certifies only the frozen local thirteen-field raw-ledger contract.

criteria.description: The source is a bounded parameterized tenant-scoped query over persisted movements joined to same-account persisted items, with inclusive dates, search, deterministic ordering, missing-join fail-closed behavior and overflow detection.
criteria.limitations: The source is limited to current persisted movement and item facts. It does not certify target roles/RLS, production scale, historical reconstruction, lots, invoices or valuation.

criteria.description: The API enforces billing.read plus inventory.read, derives account from the authenticated principal, validates source and output shape, fails closed for disabled/in-memory sources and keeps execution, audit and export on durable ReportsService.
criteria.limitations: This local route gate does not authorize fiscal writes, external providers, scheduled delivery, credentials, target operations or release acceptance.

criteria.description: The Reports Workbench forwards strict filters, consumes and validates the authenticated server execution, renders raw movement fields and does not hydrate local inventory, lots or consumptions for this report.
criteria.limitations: Browser evidence is local and disposable; it does not certify production browser policy, accessibility acceptance or deployed assets.

criteria.description: Disposable PostgreSQL proof confirms two-account isolation, inclusive date/search behavior, same-timestamp deterministic order, raw signed ledger fields, durable execution/export/audit and real 10,001-row overflow rejection before execution persistence.
criteria.limitations: The proof uses disposable local PostgreSQL/Redis and a local authenticated browser runner; it does not certify target RLS/roles, backup/restore, RTO/RPO, continuous workers or production operations.

criteria.description: Intentional RED/GREEN, focused and full regressions, builds, coverage, static/security checks, formatting, diff and empty-index hygiene satisfy the repository quality bar.

criteria.description: Fresh independent read-only review after all remediation found no scoped CRITICAL, HIGH or MEDIUM implementation finding.
